research_question: Did RCEP entry improve continuity or reactivation of supplier relationships active immediately before the COVID-19 disruption?

population.unit: Listed Chinese ticker-foreign supplier relationship by year
population.cohort_rule: Relationship must be active on 2019-12-31, involve a registered RCEP or Asian non-RCEP partner country, and map to a verified listed ticker.
population.anti_selection_rule: Do not condition cohort membership on a 2020-2024 disappearance, recovery, duration, or coefficient.

treatment.preferred: Country-specific timing: 2022 except Indonesia and the Philippines in 2023; never for controls.

outcomes.primary: Current FactSet active indicator, which permits disappearance and later reactivation.
secondary: Absorbing survival from the fixed 2019 cohort
Reactivation indicator after a prior observed absence
outcomes.interpretation: The primary outcome is pre-pandemic relationship resilience, encompassing both continuity and reactivation; it is not a pure recovery hazard.

estimating_equations.static: Active_pt = alpha_p + lambda_ft + beta TreatedCountryTime_ct + error_pt
estimating_equations.dynamic: Cohort-by-event terms with event time -1 omitted and the same fixed effects.
estimating_equations.randomization_inference: 9,999 unique assignments preserving 12 countries in the 2022 cohort, two in the 2023 cohort, and seven controls.

identifying_assumption: Absent RCEP, within the same listed firm and year, active-status changes of its fixed 2019 RCEP and Asian-control supplier relationships would have evolved in parallel.

data_gate.cohort_size: At least 500 relationships, with at least 150 RCEP and 150 control relationships.
data_gate.country_support: At least five positive cohort countries in each treatment group and at least 12 partner-country clusters overall.
data_gate.within_firm_support: At least 50 listed firms must hold both RCEP and control cohort relationships; failure stops rather than dropping firm-year fixed effects.
data_gate.balanced_panel: Each cohort relationship must have five annual observations.
data_gate.failure_rule: Failure of any support condition stops before coefficient estimation.

identification_gate.economic_threshold: Maximum absolute aggregated lead <= 0.05 probability points.
identification_gate.stop_rule: Failure stops before the static effect, bootstrap, randomization, recovery decomposition, robustness, or mechanisms.

evidence_gate.positive_result: Country-label randomization p < 0.05, consistent sign under uniform timing and absorbing survival, and no single-country sign reversal.
evidence_gate.inconclusive: Identification passes but the preferred estimate is ordinary under country assignments or too imprecise for 0.05 probability points.
evidence_gate.integrity: No disruption-defined subsample, country deletion, seed change, or subgroup significance comparison may replace the frozen result.

logs: all bootstrap and randomization draws if reached

amendment_rule: Any change after freeze is appended to pap/amendments.md before execution.
